change_summary: The paper had an expression of concern about its dose-response calculation. It was then retracted and replaced by a corrected version. The only change is the Table 3 slope, from 0.45 (CI 0.30 to 0.60) to 0.28 (CI 0.15 to 0.41) points per 10 mg of iron. The direction of the finding, that more iron gives a larger fatigue reduction, is unchanged, so severity is medium. Cite the corrected version and use the 0.28 figure.
evaluation: The draft cites Park and Singh [7] once, in the Discussion, to compare its own slope (0.41 per 10 mg) with their 0.45 and to say this supports its design. That 0.45 is exactly the figure the retraction corrected to 0.28 (CI 0.15 to 0.41). The agreement claim therefore no longer holds, and the draft's 0.41 now sits at the top of the corrected interval. It is a comparison use with medium severity, so the impact is low. Still, update the number, cite the corrected version, and reword the validity claim.
recommendation: Update the Discussion to use the corrected slope of 0.28 (CI 0.15 to 0.41) instead of 0.45, and cite the corrected version of Park and Singh. Then reword the claim that the similarity supports your design, since 0.41 is no longer close to their value.
